Name: Nyx's Wizard Furniture Catalogue Ultimate Recolor
Author: NyxInReverie
Description:
[size=4]This started as a simple recolor but quickly ballooned into a giant project. There are 24 colors to choose from (8 each of light, medium, and dark), 4 accent colors (copper, iron, gold, and iridium), 4 wood types (birch, oak, mahogany, and walnut) and 3 shades of stone (light, medium, and dark)! [/size]

[size=4]This mod is currently only available for Content Patcher and replaces the vanilla Wizard Catalogue, but I am working on an Alternative Textures version![/size]

[size=4][b]Default[/b]: Dark Multi-Color, Gold, Walnut, Dark Stone[/size]

[size=4][b]24 Main Colors:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][b][u]Light[/u][/b]: Multi-color, Yellow, Orange, Green, Teal, Blue, Purple, Pink[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b][u]Medium[/u][/b]: Multi-color, Red, Orange, Green, Teal, Blue, Purple, Pink[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b][u]Dark[/u][/b]: Multi-color, Red, Orange, Green, Teal, Blue, Purple, Pink[/size][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]4 Accent Colors[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Copper, Iron, Gold, [/size][size=3]Iridium[/size][/*]
[/list][b][size=4]4 Wood Types[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Birch, Oak, Mahogany, Walnut[/size][/*]
[/list][b][size=4]3 Stone Shades[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Light, Medium, Dark[/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=4]This mod includes an i18n file for the config. Feel free to create and upload translation files![/size]

[size=4][b]Future Plans[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]AT version[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Extra furniture not already included in the original catalogue: child bed, couch, window, etc.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Other Mods Shown[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/91802318][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/91802318]grapeponta[/url][/*]
[*][size=3]My [i]soon-ish[/i] to be released Farmhouse map[/size][/*]
[/list]
